title: EdOS Edge Telemetry and Compliance Heartbeat Kernel
scope: Re-architects observability + compliance + lifecycle + sync_engine + platform_runtime around encrypted telemetry packets, local offline telemetry buffer, sync error packet, compliance heartbeat, corruption warning, payment sync failure, bandwidth-aware upload priority, central cloud ingestion, operator alerting, no PII by default, edge node status dashboard, rural/low-connectivity proof model, PWA sync health, edge manifest health, School-in-a-Box heartbeat contract.

sections.title: Telemetry packet contracts
items: Encrypted at rest in apps.sync_engine.offline_telemetry_buffer (PWA IndexedDB)
PII fields EXCLUDED by default; only redacted-class summaries (counts, hashes)
Bandwidth-aware priority — heartbeat > sync_error > corruption > payment_sync_failure > performance_sample

sections.title: Packet types
items: edge_heartbeat — every 60s when online; queued offline
payment_sync_failure — rail_id + error_code + retry_count (NO amounts, NO account numbers)

sections.title: Honest deferred posture
items: Live edge node ingestion DEFERRED — contracts shipped, central ingestion endpoint live, edge node deployments external.
School-in-a-Box hardware DEFERRED — heartbeat contract shipped, physical hardware pilots external.

external_blockers: live PSP settlement reconciliation per corridor
MoE / Ministry of Education per-country live integrations
USSD telecom partner agreements per country
native push notification wrapper (Capacitor/Tauri) — deferred until first-100-schools proof
live LiteLLM API keys on Render
Postgres RLS enforced in production (current local env is SQLite)
pwa_posture: PWA is the launch mobile strategy. Native iOS/Android apps are explicitly DEFERRED until web core stability + first-100-schools proof + PWA installability proof. Service worker + manifest + IndexedDB + offline queue shipped in prior batches; this re-architecture preserves and consumes that infrastructure rather than forking.
honesty_notes: Repo-scope contracts only — no live vendor integration claims.
Existing canonical models preserved; metadata layer absorbs tenant variance per architecture correction.
External blockers listed above remain unchanged by batch 1489.
